prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and preferred services. I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me give a tailored shortlist:

- What are your primary goals? (e.g., lead generation, e‑commerce sales, brand awareness, SEO, local search, content marketing, social ads)
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget?
- Company size and industry (B2B, B2C, e‑commerce, nonprofit)?
- Do you want a local St. Louis agency you can meet in person, or are remote agencies fine?
- Any must‑have services or platforms (Google Ads, Facebook/Meta, SEO, HubSpot, Shopify, Magento, etc.)?

How I’ll help once you answer: I’ll produce a short list (3–5) of St. Louis agencies that match your needs, include strengths/weaknesses, examples of relevant case studies, estimated pricing ranges, and suggested interview questions.

If you want to start looking on your own right away, use these resources and evaluation criteria:

Where to find agencies
- Review sites: Clutch.co, UpCity, Expertise
- Google Maps / Google Business Profiles (look for reviews and photos)
- LinkedIn company pages and staff profiles
- Local business publications and awards (St. Louis Business Journal lists, local marketing meetups)

How to evaluate agencies
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (not just designs)
- Industry experience (have they worked with brands like yours?)
- Certifications and partnerships (Google Partner, Meta, HubSpot)
- Reporting cadence and KPIs (how will success be measured?)
- Team composition and who will do the work (senior vs. outsourced)
- Pricing model (retainer, hourly, performance, project)
- Contract terms and minimums
- Client references you can call

Interview questions to ask
- What measurable results did you achieve for a client like us?
- Who will be our day‑to‑day contact and can we meet them?
- What tools and platforms do you use for reporting and campaign management?
- How do you allocate budget between channels?
- Can you share recent case studies and references?

Tell me your goals and constraints and I’ll shortlist the best St. Louis agencies for your situation.
